d:
A comic about 1998's cult classic Metal Gear Solid's Sniper Wolf latest moment of life just after she was shot by Solid Snake, an alternate take of the story where Solid Snake does not executes her but leaves her to die on the snowy field where the last battle between the two happens in-game.

Sniper Wolf is from Kurdistan, Iran.

Iran is now (March 2026) at war with Israel.

I wanted to write something war-themed but also relevant and actual, and when I connected the dots, this story came to mind, so here it is this anti-war comic.

This comic is a denouncement on the horrors of wars and how they twist the new generation that is unwillingly involved into conflicts, using Sniper Wolf backstory as a proxy to that.

I personally think war is but an excuse to let (dirty) money keep flowing and circulate, everythinge ls but gammon giving for the masses.
